name: jobcan
title: Jobcan
description: Manage your Jobcan time tracking via Raycast
author: clins1994

commands.name: show-attendance
commands.title: Show Attendance
commands.description: Shows attendance for a given month

preferences.name: username
preferences.title: Username
preferences.description: Your Jobcan email address or staff code.

preferences.name: defaultStartTime
preferences.title: Default Start Time
preferences.description: Default clock-in time to use for future attendance requests.

preferences.name: defaultEndTime
preferences.title: Default End Time
preferences.description: Default clock-out time to use for future attendance requests.

preferences.name: defaultNotice
preferences.title: Default Note
preferences.description: Default required note to use for attendance requests.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
